strings: m_c heads to the medicine den, hoping that r_c0 will give {PRONOUN/m_c/object} some poppy seeds to help dampen the nightmares that have been plaguing {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c's hallucinations have followed {PRONOUN/m_c/object} into slumber.
m_c is scared to fall asleep - hallucinations have infiltrated {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} dreams as well.
Another nightmare drags m_c down, leaving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} tired and hollow looking the next day to the worry of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates.
